blind.description: Three upright ovoid eggs arranged in a tight triangle inside a low circular nest ring. The eggshells are smooth and solid with a glossy mottled red, amber, and gold pattern. The nest ring is a lumpy, organic torus textured in dark grey-charcoal with yellowish mottling. All surfaces are solid and fully connected, with the eggs resting naturally inside the rim and the base sitting flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: Three circular red-and-gold mottled egg tops clustered tightly together within a textured dark circular nest rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall) and approximately 2 ft wide.
